primo 0.2.0

build: Release, sanitizers: none
cadical: cadical-3.0.0-7b99c07

design.schedule: SHA256 of JSON [seed, input, repeat, configuration], ascending within input/repetition; input hash order; whole inputs round-robin across 64 shards
design.correctness: Every successful SAT timing row gets a separate exact-profile native check-model plus Dolmen replay after all timing jobs finish. Known answers checked against frozen labels. Unknown candidate separate from scored results.
design.scope: Fresh numerical conjunction replay; no default promotion, tuning or warm basis replay.

provenance.preflight: Repository --check-only --no-sync from clean d4944eb worktree immediately before every submission; immutable qualified native binary reused
provenance.fuzz_asan_static_scope: Historical exact-native d4944eb gates reused; no fresh native implementation or default promotion.

interpretation.score: Mean over repetitions of the summed 999-input process PAR2; all unsolved repetitions cost30s
interpretation.paired: Ratio of per-input median durations/work on positive fully completed triplets; baseline/variant >1 means variant faster/less work
interpretation.intervals: 2000 counting-parent bootstrap samples, seed20261031. PAR2 interval units are mean seconds per input, not total score seconds.
interpretation.selection: Corpus deliberately selected using production-default numerical-call costs; this is a fresh-conjunction case study, not full SMT solving or an unbiased population sample.
interpretation.unknown: One frozen unknown excluded from scored999; all48 of its runs retained separately
interpretation.claim: Existing-setting ablation only; no new algorithm or default promotion
